lines.en: I inch forward, arching and stretching.
Dozens of little legs move together.

lines.zh: 我沿着叶脉走，不敢掉队
lines.en: I follow the leaf vein and don't wander off.
I stop at the leaf's edge.
The underside of the leaf is my road.

lines.zh: 掉下去就完了，所以我抓得紧
lines.en: A fall would be the end, so I grip hard.

lines.zh: 丘陵上的风一吹，叶子晃
lines.en: The hill wind shakes the leaf.
I chew a path and keep going.
My body extends and contracts, slowly.
I only walk on this tree.
The nibbled leaf edge is mine.
Another one is following behind.
I move onto another leaf.
There's light overhead; I won't go.
My green body hugs the green leaf.
An inch a step; take it slow.

lines.zh: 我挂在叶子上，一动不动
lines.en: I hang on the leaf, quite still.
I'm still chewing.
The leaf tastes a little bitter.
I don't dare leave this leaf.
The bands on my body shift as I breathe.
I'm growing thicker by the day.
The one beside me has stopped moving.
I've chewed the leaf's edge bare.
Dew slides off the leaf tip.
The dew on my leaf is drying
My back itches a little.
This leaf will last a few more days.
Your hand is enormous.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我掉下去就没了
lines.en: Don't touch me; if I fall I'm gone.
I can only crawl, not fly.
You're looking at a worm.

lines.zh: 我脚下这片叶子是我的
lines.en: This leaf under me is mine.
You're blocking the light.

lines.zh: 把我挪到另一片叶子上吧
lines.en: Move me to another leaf.
I'm about to change.
Look up, I'm right here.
Your shadow makes me cold.
My body curls into a ball.
Green juice stains the leaf.
I held on and didn't fall.
That made me shrink half an inch.
I'm soft; any touch stings.
I slowly uncurl.
A small tear on my back.
I move toward the leaf's center.
Don't touch me again.
I'm alive, only slower.
Leaves; I only eat leaves.
This one's too old; I won't eat.
Set the leaf beside me.
Don't try me with anything else.
Tender ones are best.
I eat all day.
I can't finish this one.
Just move me somewhere.
The leaf must be fresh.
Another leaf, that's all.
You touched the leaf.
The leaf swayed and I held on.
Don't push; a fall would end me.
I'm soft; collisions don't hurt.
You stepped on the leaf.
I slipped half a step at the leaf's edge.
I nearly lost my grip.
We're crowded on one leaf.
You're in the path.
Let me pass, slowly.
I need to grow a while longer.
There are others on this tree.
Two of us chew side by side.
We won't be together long.

lines.zh: 叶子底下有它们的痕迹
lines.en: There are traces of them under the leaf.

lines.zh: 以后我会变成会飞的东西
lines.en: Later I'll become something that flies.
Wait until I grow wings
I haven't made my chrysalis yet.

lines.zh: 你说的那个，是成虫的事
lines.en: That's a matter for the adult.
Don't disturb me, I'm eating.
I can't pick anything up.
I carry a bit of leaf in my mouth.
Things on the ground are out of reach.
I only chew, I don't hold.
There's something on this leaf.
I push it away.
This isn't edible.

lines.zh: 我把啃下的碎屑推下去
lines.en: I push the crumbs I chewed off the edge.
Everything here is too hard.
I can't carry anything away.
There's a tender leaf over there.
I see it, on the next branch.
Not far.
Grip this one first, then move.
The veins connect.
That one is brighter.
I'll have to shift slowly.
One more foot and I can reach it
Can't rush; I'd fall.
Almost there.
Inch by inch.
I shift my grip.
The leaf sways; I wait for it to settle.
That path is too thin.
Half an inch more.
I go around the leaf's tear.
The stem is just ahead.
My legs can't reach.
The wind stopped; hurry.
Nearly there.
I can only shove a little.
I butt with my head.
That was utterly soft.
I bit the leaf, not you.
I have no teeth.
If you step, I can't dodge.
I curl up; that's my defense.
This strength hurts no one.
I twist my body.
One nudge, then back to chewing my leaf
An egg opened on the leaf's back.
I crawl out along the vein.
My first bite was leaf.
The leaves on these hills are tender.
I look up; the light is too bright.
Dozens of us came out together.
There's a new hole in the leaf.
I grip my first leaf.
The wind blows, so I grip the leaf vein
I don't belong on the ground.
Flame caught the leaf before it caught me.
I fell and landed on soil.

lines.zh: 水滴把我裹住，我挣不出来
lines.en: A drop wraps me and I can't get out.
The blast knocked me off the leaf.
A small thorn went through me.
The spell hit and I clenched up.
No leaf to eat, and I'm drying out.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我抖成一团
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree and I shook tight.

lines.zh: 虚空里什么都没有，连叶子都没有
lines.en: Nothing in the void, not even a leaf.
